note: Spring 2026 (Bi-Semester), Department of Law & Justice (LL.B, LL.M): 1 Jan to 2 Jul 2026, 14.5 teaching weeks. Dates are recorded as printed; two printed weekdays are wrong (14 Apr 2026 "Thursday" is a Tuesday; the supplementary mid-term "05 Apr - 09 Apr, Sunday - Monday" ends on a Thursday). The supplementary final examination (28 Jun - 2 Jul) falls inside the semester break, as printed. Club, wellbeing, census, parents', sports and research-showcase days and staff deadlines are left out. classes-pause is the last class before the mid-term, not the end of teaching.
